title: feat(setup): 'Connect an agent' page — MCP URL, per-client connect cards, API keys, SKILL.md download
body:
## Context

framework#2698 made every deployment self-serve connectable over MCP: OAuth 2.1 with DCR shipped in framework#2709, and framework#2712 turned the MCP surface **default-on** (`/api/v1/discovery` now advertises `routes.mcp` out of the box; `OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED=false` opts out). What's missing is the product surface that makes this visible to a non-technical admin: today you have to read docs to learn the URL even exists.

## Deliverable

A **"Connect an agent"** page in the Setup app — an admin/user connects an AI client in under three minutes without knowing what MCP is.

### Page content

- [ ] **This environment's MCP URL**, prominent, with copy button (read from `/api/v1/discovery` → `routes.mcp`, resolved against the deployment origin)
- [ ] **Per-client connect cards**, each with copy-paste-ready content:
  - claude.ai — paste URL as a custom connector (note: requires the deployment to be publicly reachable over HTTPS)
  - Claude Desktop — paste URL as a connector
  - Claude Code — full `claude mcp add --transport http <name> <url>` command; link the official plugin (framework#2713) as the recommended path
  - Cursor / generic MCP client — URL + note that OAuth discovery is automatic
  - OAuth is the default story on every card ("open the browser login as yourself"); no admin-minted credentials in the happy path
- [ ] **API key minting** for headless agents/CI: calls the existing `POST /api/v1/keys`, shows the key once, supports scopes/expiry — with copy for the `x-api-key` header form
- [ ] **Download SKILL.md** button — serves the environment-customized generic skill (see framework dependency below)
- [ ] Hide the page (or show an "MCP disabled" empty state) when discovery does not advertise `routes.mcp`
- [ ] i18n (en + zh-CN), Setup nav registration

### Framework dependency (small, can land first)

`renderSkillMarkdown()` in `@objectstack/mcp` is export-only today — nothing serves it over HTTP. Add `GET /api/v1/mcp/skill` (public or session-gated) returning `renderSkillMarkdown({ mcpUrl: <this env's URL> })` as `text/markdown`. Tracked as a checklist item here; split into a framework issue if preferred.

- [ ] framework: `GET /api/v1/mcp/skill` endpoint

## Non-goals

- No per-app skill variants (ADR-0036 Amendment C: one generic skill)
- Connector-directory listing (cloud-side, tracked separately)

Refs framework#2698.
